single_variable: Measure the historical drawdown on the native funding-aware FVG-priority wallet with official one-minute Binance futures candles for its critical H1 peak. Freeze all capital, fees, orders, child quantities, partial fills and funding cashflows.
selection: For each exact funding/slippage scenario, locate the prior H1 upper peak of the maximum conservative drawdown. Intersect that single H1 with finer market observations. If a witnessed peak and a later actual H1 stage imply a drawdown over 35%, that alone rules out this policy. Otherwise retain the upper bound of the rest of the entire curve; a remaining straddle is explicitly unresolved.
math: Compute 60 portfolio NAV intervals from per-symbol ranges and include the previous minute's last trade in each range to avoid a falsely synchronized opening price. For each still-open instrument an actual favorable traded price occurs somewhere within its minute, while every other instrument is bounded adversely. Keep the largest such guaranteed lower bound on the earlier peak. Unknown intrahour exits and strict in-hour funding are bracketed conservatively. Reconcile complete native minute OHLC to the frozen futures hour and end-marked account NAV to its four-stage ledger.
